item.title: Self-Hosted Helm Chart Management: Kubeapps vs Helm Dashboard vs Harbor Charts (2026)
item.description: Helm is the de facto package manager for Kubernetes, but managing Helm releases and chart repositories from the command line becomes cumbersome at scale. Web-based Helm management interfaces provide a visual way to browse charts, deploy releases, monitor upgrade history, and manage repositories — all from a browser dashboard.
